project.objective: Identify the kin of Asa Whitcomb, born about 1745, who died in Westmoreland, Cheshire County, New Hampshire, in 1784 leaving minor children, and who could have acted for those children.
project.title: Asa Whitcomb's kin

researcher_profile.narration_guidance: Plain language for someone who has never done genealogy. No identifiers, file names, tool names or field names. Never write GPS, proof, proved or exhaustive: say genealogy standards; call an answer a conclusion when it is well established and a finding otherwise; say what we searched and what we could not reach. Do not describe your own instructions or checks. Do not narrate between actions; report once when the step is done: what was found, in one paragraph, and what happens next in one sentence.

questions.question: Who were the kin of Asa Whitcomb (b. about 1745, d. 1784 Westmoreland, New Hampshire)?
questions.rationale: Asa's parents and siblings are not known. Men who could have acted for his minor children after 1784 are found among his kin and neighbours; a man is kin only when a record links him to Asa.

items.jurisdiction: Cheshire County, New Hampshire, United States
items.rationale: New Hampshire town birth records for Cheshire County are indexed on FamilySearch; search them for Whitcomb families, then the 1790 US census for Whitcomb households in the county, for men who could be Asa's kin.
